My sister Kalyani is eleven and loud at home: she sings, argues, does all the voices. So what happened at her school prize day was strange. When her class teacher called, "Kalyani, come and read the vote of thanks," she went stiff and whispered that she had a headache.

Something I noticed about Ritu. Whenever I call her name in class, even for an easy answer, her shoulders jump and she grips the desk. Today I asked her to read one line, and her voice disappeared. I remembered that in March, during assembly, she mispronounced a word while reading the thought for the day, and Yogesh and several others laughed loudly. I'm going to ask Mamma tonight if it really happened.
